# SectionHeader

The one small label, the same wherever it sits: a sans-xs title in text-tertiary, uppercase by default, optionally with an icon before it and a figure on the r…

`NomNom.SectionHeader` · Layout

## Use

```jsx
<NomNom.SectionHeader title="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="NomNom.SectionHeader" title="…"></x-import>
```

## Notes

The one small label, wherever it sits — above a list or inside a card. It draws no surface and reserves no space around itself; the parent does both. Pass `title` to Section, SectionCard or Card rather than nesting a header, and those place it correctly.

## Props (SectionHeaderProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` * | `string` |  |
| `uppercase` | `boolean` | false sets the label as written, for a possessive or personal label ("Joel's note"). @default true |
| `trailing` | `unknown` | One figure on the right — a count, a byline, a score. Never a second label, never a button. |
| `trailingVariant` | `'secondary' \| 'primary'` | 'primary' makes the figure primary-text, for a live count. |
| `icon` | `IconName` |  |
| `variant` | `'primary'` | 'primary' — title primary-text semibold. Only inside a featured card, and only on one label there. |
| `as` | `string` | The title element: 'h2' above content, 'span' inside a card or header. @default 'h2' |
